cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Let the Callback Claim Credit
cards.instruction: Get recognition by returning to an early overlooked contribution when its importance becomes undeniable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Remember when I made you put a spare key under the flowerpot? You rolled your eyes through my whole lesson on getting locked out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And now neither of us has a key in a pocket. You've checked both coats this time; good. Try the pot.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Whose good idea? Give me the full sentence, like I taught you: 'Your spare key got us in.' Then lift the pot.
